name: tracking-proof-support-resilience
objective: Close assignment-scoped tracking/PoD recovery and converge Captain support/incidents/rescue on one governed DSH path with privacy, retry and cleanup proof.
truthOwner: DSH owns delivery/status/location references/support/incidents/rescue; governed media owns proof assets where contracted; WLT is visibility-only from rescue; app-captain renders and sends authorized intent only.

tasks.objective: Close tracking, delivery status and PoD under stale assignment, retry and unknown-result conditions
tasks.currentProblem: Current wiring does not itself prove actor/assignment isolation, duplicate safety, device permission/lifecycle behavior, weak-network recovery, media binding or canonical freshness.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise backend/app contracts plus device scenarios; reproduce any stale/local/fabricated transition; repair the DSH/media/runtime owner, remove stale local completion state and verify every affected readback.
tasks.targetState: Location/status/PoD effects are assignment-bound, duplicate-safe and canonically read back; permission/network/restart failure cannot fabricate completion or leak protected data.
tasks.action: Test valid and wrong/stale assignment mutations, duplicate submissions, permission denied/granted, capture/upload retry, network unknown result and restart/readback; fix root cause, rerun app/backend/contract checks and attach physical-device evidence when native behavior is affected.
mustNotChange: Do not add background tracking merely because foreground behavior exists.
Do not store unnecessary location history locally.
Do not mark location/proof/delivery success from uncertain client-local state.
Do not bypass media/assignment ownership to make capture succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong/stale assignment and cross-actor location/PoD mutations are rejected.
Duplicate/retry behavior cannot create duplicate proof or illegal state progression.
Unknown/offline result recovers through canonical readback rather than fabricated success.
Client/operator readers see only role-appropriate tracking/proof data.
When native paths change, physical-device permission/restart/weak-network evidence is attached to the exact candidate.
No known stale local completion/privacy defect remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused owner fix while preserving actor/assignment scope and canonical recovery; never restore local success truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused tracking/PoD change set with native evidence if native behavior changes.

tasks.objective: Eliminate Captain support route contradiction and close assigned-order support/rescue boundaries
tasks.currentProblem: `orderchat` renders disabled while `chat-read-ack` and `chat-send` route to the Product-Truth-backed CaptainOrderSupportConversationScreen, leaving a known contradictory path plus unproven ownership/conflict/rescue behavior.
tasks.requiredChange: Perform complete route/navigation/deep-link caller census; classify `orderchat` as canonical, alias or dead; converge every live entry on one support model; remove obsolete route/type/copy where safe; then test assigned/unassigned, internal-note, retry/conflict, audit and operator rescue boundaries.
tasks.targetState: Exactly one governed Captain assigned-order support conversation behavior exists, with no contradictory live alias, cross-order access, internal-note leak, local rescue truth or DSH financial mutation.
tasks.action: Map route registry, renderer, support router and callers; execute support backend/app/contract tests; exercise unassigned/cross-actor/internal-note/stale-state cases; repair owner logic and remove/delegate obsolete presentation only after reachability proof; rerun cleanup and full caller census.
mustNotChange: Do not expose internal operator notes to Captain.
Do not allow support for an unassigned order.
Do not let Captain mutate rescue/incident operator state.
Do not mutate WLT ledger/balance/refund/settlement from DSH rescue.
Do not retain two independently behaving live Captain support routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Every live Captain support entry reaches one canonical governed conversation model; obsolete aliases/routes/types/copy are removed or intentionally delegated.
Captain cannot create/read another or unassigned order conversation and cannot read internal notes.
Retry/conflict returns canonical state without stale overwrite; required audit/read receipts/attachments remain contract-aligned.
Rescue state is operator-owned, audited and financially read-only from DSH.
No known dead/duplicate/contradictory support residue remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused support convergence commit only if it preserves the single canonical model and authorization boundaries; never restore divergent live routes.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused support/route cleanup commit separate from tracking and finance.
